rows.text: The Élysée states that 'Le mardi 15 mai 2012 à 10h00, M. François Hollande a été accueilli par M. Nicolas Sarkozy au Palais de l'Élysée' following his election on 6 May 2012 as seventh President of the Fifth Republic, and that after their meeting he accompanied M. Nicolas Sarkozy to the steps.

rows.text: It states that he then received from General Georgelin, Grand Chancellor, the insignia of Grand Master of the Legion of Honour, and that the investiture ceremony continued with the proclamation of the official results presided over by Jean-Louis Debré, President of the Constitutional Council.
